aesthetic: The Resolution Layer — a household stitched from decaying signals, read on an identity console
anchor: The corpus's unit of identity is the pseudonymous token — a hashed email or a UID2 string standing in for a person — and its central tension is the gap between what a signal claims to resolve and what it actually resolves (an IP 'matches' a household 13% of the time; a platform 'reaches' 90% by its own unaudited count). So the world is an identity-resolution console: the OpenRTB user.eids[] array of truncated hex tokens, signal traces of different confidence converging on one household, and a match-rate readout that always shows the claimed bar ghosted behind the verified one. Cobalt is the verified signal; a ghost-grey is the claim that did not land.
rationale: The structural metaphor is RESOLUTION — many fragmentary, decaying signals (HEM, MAID, IP, ACR, device ID, login) stitched, or failing to stitch, into one persistent household identity. Figures should read like a modern identity/telemetry console, not a humanities study: thin signal traces, monospace tokens, confidence bands rather than crisp lines, and the recurring claimed-vs-verified gap. The brand accent is SIGNAL COBALT — a true electric blue deliberately absent from the rest of the ad-tech shelf (which runs teal, emerald, violet, rose, amber, red-orange), so this corpus separates at a glance from its siblings while still reading as instrument-grade rather than decorative. The five figure hues map to the five signal families: cobalt (HEM, the deterministic spine), cyan (IP / geolocation), amber (MAID, the decaying signal — caution), rose (ACR / content), green (first-party login, the durable one). Cool console paper for day; a true dark inspector-at-night for evening. Sharp small radii, a technical grotesque for display, a readable transitional serif for the long-form body, and a true monospace for the hashed tokens and OpenRTB field names that recur throughout.

fonts.display: 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, Arial, sans-serif
fonts.body: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
